internet.reason: The server part fetches OpenStreetMap tiles for the tile proxy. For development and demonstrations only; not used in disconnected installations.

groups.label: Upstream
groups.description: The tile server the plugin fetches from, and how long it waits for a tile.

groups.label: Tiles served
groups.description: The zoom levels the plugin offers the map, and how many tiles it keeps in memory.

upstreamUrl.title: Tile URL
upstreamUrl.description: Upstream tile URL template with {z}, {x} and {y}. Its host need not be listed in internet.hosts: that field declares that the plugin goes online (default host and reason).

x-emc2.hint: Tile URL with {z}, {x} and {y}; any host, set by an administrator

maxZoom.title: Highest zoom level
maxZoom.description: Highest zoom level served and offered to the map view.

cacheTiles.title: Tiles in the cache
cacheTiles.description: Number of tiles kept in the in-memory cache of the tile proxy (least recently used are dropped).

x-emc2.hint: Tiles kept in memory; the least recently used go first

upstreamTimeoutSeconds.title: Tile request timeout
upstreamTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one upstream tile request may take before it is cut off.
